name: ReelDo — Saved reels to tasks
description: Sync your open Instagram Saved or TikTok Favourites page into local lists. File import also supported.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:11434; img-src 'self' data: https://*.cdninstagram.com https://*.fbcdn.net
